cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(UvePluginLoadCheck LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(UVE_PLAYER_DIR "" CACHE PATH "UVE Player source folder (src/plugins/PluginApi.h)")
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui)
add_executable(uve-plugin-loadcheck main.cpp)
target_include_directories(uve-plugin-loadcheck PRIVATE "${UVE_PLAYER_DIR}/src/plugins")
target_link_libraries(uve-plugin-loadcheck PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(uve-plugin-loadcheck PRIVATE /utf-8 /Zc:__cplusplus /permissive-)
endif()
